mutants.description: A projection must choose the nearest specified RGB center, including the blue sample and first tie.
Adaptive fallback must respect the configured maximum cluster count.
The configured adaptive distance limit is inclusive; an exact radius boundary must be accepted without increasing the cluster count.
Remeshing must reject a label array that cannot be indexed per input face.
The public closure predicate must report watertight cubes as closed and open squares as open.
The configured 0.3 threshold is part of the smoothing contract and must activate at equality.
Failed UV validation must clear both output collections so callers cannot observe stale component UVs.
Every face must receive the center selected by its computed cluster ID, not the first center unconditionally.
Nearest-color lookup must retain the smallest CIEDE2000 distance and select the exact blue center.
